name: a2ui-render
description: Render A2UI surfaces from Claude's replies as native, interactive UI in Claude Code (Desktop Code tab and terminal). Button actions go back to Claude.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Default look for A2UI surfaces: clean (neutral, follows the app), soft (tinted cards, labels above fields), accent (colored borders and headings). A surface can pick its own with createSurface.theme.

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: Color used by the accent theme, progress bars, charts and avatars.

send_as.title: Send button actions as
send_as.description: mod: Claude sees the action as coming from this plugin. user: the action is sent as if you typed it.

gestures.title: Swipe gestures
gestures.description: Let carousels with "swipe": true be dragged with the mouse. Turn off if cards don't show or dragging misbehaves; Back / Next buttons always work.
